recommendations.executive_summary: The proposed Artisanal Single-Origin Kopi Bar at S$3.00 demonstrates moderate risk due to its positioning between the Indifference Price Point (IPP) and Point of Marginal Expensiveness (PME). While the mean purchase intent of 77.7% and positive sentiment indicate a favorable reception, there is significant resistance from core customer segments, particularly concerning taste comparison with traditional hawker kopi. Strategic adjustments in pricing and value offerings are essential to enhance consumer confidence and capitalize on the existing demand.

recommendations.recommended_pivot: Reposition the price closer to the Optimal Price Point (S$5.05) while introducing value bundling options such as toast sets with coffee for S$6.50. Implement acceptance of CDC vouchers to incentivize purchases and create promotional offers during peak hours to increase foot traffic. Highlight the unique quality of the artisanal kopi through targeted marketing campaigns to address taste concerns.
